description: This file defines the Oracle database driver class for the ADOdb PHP library, including connection management, SQL formatting, transaction control, and error handling. It also includes classes for handling Oracle-specific recordsets and field metadata.

classes.name: ADODB_oracle
classes.description: Handles Oracle database connections, SQL formatting, and transactions for the ADOdb PHP library.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oracle
classes.description: Represents an Oracle-specific recordset, providing methods to fetch data and metadata from query results.

methods.name: DBDate
methods.description: Formats a date value into Oracle's TO_DATE function syntax.

methods.name: DBTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp value into Oracle's TO_DATE function with time component.

methods.name: BindDate
methods.description: Prepares a date string for binding, removing quotes if present.

methods.name: BindTimeStamp
methods.description: Prepares a timestamp string for binding, removing quotes if present.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction by disabling autocommit.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits a transaction, rolling back if indicated.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from Oracle.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves the last error code from Oracle.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Oracle database using provided credentials and options.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Oracle database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query on the Oracle database.
